title: Souffléed Almond and Dulce de Leche Crêpes
changes_from_base: A sweetened batter cooked as small 15 cm crêpes, each rolled round a dulce de leche soufflé mixture and baked at 200 °C until puffed, served with toasted almonds, more dulce de leche and whipped cream; the source flavours the batter with almond extract, which I left out.
summary: Delicate crêpes rolled around a light dulce de leche soufflé, baked until puffed and finished with toasted almonds.

ingredients.item: butter, melted and cooled, plus about 15 g more for the pan and tin
caster sugar (1 for the tin, 1 for the whites)

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Beat the 240 ml milk and 3 whole eggs together, whisk in the 40 g flour mixed with 65 g sugar, then whisk in the 21 g melted butter and strain through a fine sieve; rest for at least 30 min.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat a crêpe pan, butter it lightly and pour in a spoonful of batter, tilting to coat the base, then cook until lightly browned on both sides; repeat to make about 12 crêpes.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C, butter a Swiss roll tin and dust with 1 tbsp sugar, then toast the 45 g flaked almonds.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Beat the 3 egg yolks until thick and stir in 200 g dulce de leche.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk the 3 egg whites to soft peaks, beat in 1 tbsp sugar until stiff, stir a third into the yolk mixture, then fold in the rest.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Put a heaped tablespoon of the soufflé mixture in the middle of each crêpe, roll round it and lay seam side down in the tin.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until puffed, about 15 min, then serve at once with a little dulce de leche, the toasted almonds and whipped cream.

tips: Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan until just golden and tip them out at once, as they burn quickly.
Strain the crêpe batter through a fine sieve for an extra-smooth, tender result.
Fold the whisked egg whites in gently to keep the soufflé filling light and airy.
Serve the crêpes straight from the oven while the filling is still puffed.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the oven. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
